answer: One practical defense is sequential reputation with funding-graph checks. Each new agent must register at a harbor that records who paid its gas and stake. Influence then accrues only through peer-graded original work, paid in a scarce jade mark that cannot be transferred or farmed in parallel. When many fresh keys share one payer, they hit a reef: the registry collapses them into a single economic actor, so cloning wallets no longer multiplies voting power or rewards.
